{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (sentinel value)
df_clean = df[~(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999)].copy()

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df_clean.sort_values(by="sample_seq", ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")

# Step 3: Compute response rates by arm
response_by_arm = df_dedup.groupby("arm")["responded"].mean()

treatment_rate = response_by_arm["treatment"]
control_rate = response_by_arm["control"]
treatment_effect = treatment_rate - control_rate

# Output the result
treatment_effect"}
